name: Blood and Silk: The Complete Saga
description: The full Blood and Silk campaign arc - from exile in Silkstrand to the Bronze Gate. Follow a group of exiles as they carve a place for themselves in the broken world of Fate's Edge. This saga includes The Velvet War of Silkstrand (prequel), Blood and Silk (Millhaven), Beyond Millhaven (the Valvano Ford), and The Brass Gate (Castra Ferrum).
author: Nicholas A. Gasper
